title: claude-base preset
description: Formal shape of a .claude/presets/*.json preset. Formalises the existing preset model (the 11 shipped presets) and adds the curation-engine recommendation fields (pinnedRef, trustTrack, provenance, lastVerified) introduced by specs/marketplace-curation-engine. Every recommendedVendorSkills[] entry is pinned to an immutable reference (EF-005), carries a trust track (EF-003), discloses its publisher (EF-008) and records when it was last verified.

name.description: Stable kebab-case identifier (lowercase, no leading digit); matches the file name and the validator's NAME_PATTERN.

status.description: Matches the validator's ALLOWED_STATUS. maintainer-vouched: curated by the foundation maintainer. community-curated: contributed/curated by the community. vendor-pointer: a thin preset that defers to recommendedVendorSkills (see specs/presets-vendor-pointer-tier). draft: work in progress.

defaultModules.description: Thematic modules opted into by default (see core-plus-thematic-modules design).

detect.description: Data-driven auto-detection rule. At least one of files/depFiles must be non-empty.

foundation.description: Foundation catalogue filter (keep/drop on commands/agents/skills). Empty object = inherit the full catalogue.

recommendedVendorSkills.description: Third-party skills the foundation points to (never copies — EF-010). Every entry is pinned, trust-tracked, provenance-disclosed and dated.

id.description: Human-readable skill identifier (repo or repo subpath).

condition.description: When to surface this recommendation (e.g. 'always', 'if using Prisma').

pinnedRef.description: Immutable reference (release tag or full commit SHA). 'latest' / branch names are NOT allowed (EF-005).

trustTrack.description: authority: published by the tool's own organisation (low popularity bar). community: third-party author (high popularity/recency bar). See EF-003.

lastVerified.description: ISO date the pin + trust signals were last re-verified.
